notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Ingestion → Scene Forensics reads the real footage's lighting, camera motion, and spatial layout → Insert Director specifies a character/object to add, its entry point, and its behavior, matched to the scene's real lighting direction and perspective → Omni Flash 1.1 video-to-video generates the insert with the source footage as structural/lighting reference, preserving the real background exactly → Integration Critic (does the inserted element cast correct shadows, match perspective, and hold up under a 'play it again' rewatch?) → Repair on any integration seam → Package.

requires.name: Base video — uploaded or previously generated

notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Ingestion → Base Generation produces or accepts the starting video → Edit-Request Parser converts each natural-language note ('make the lighting warmer', 'swap the background to a kitchen', 'change the camera to a low angle') into a structured Interactions-API turn → Omni Flash 1.1 applies each edit conversationally, preserving everything not mentioned in that turn → Turn-by-Turn Diff Critic confirms only the requested change occurred (no unintended drift elsewhere in frame) → Repair (re-issue the turn with tighter scoping) on any unintended drift → Final-state Package once the director approves the accumulated edits.

STAGE 3 — TURN-BY-TURN DIFF CRITIC Confirms only the requested change occurred in each turn — unintended drift anywhere else in frame is the failure this stage exists to catch.

M-VT0486_Autonomous_Trend_Detection___Ra.title: VT0486. Autonomous Trend-Detection & Rapid-Response Pipeline #16
M-VT0486_Autonomous_Trend_Detection___Ra.summary: TREND SCANNER No trend is given — the system finds one.
M-VT0486_Autonomous_Trend_Detection___Ra.pipeline: 2× text-input → prompt → reference-image-input → concat → pinterest-scraper → image-randomizer → 4× text-gen → 3× image-gen → 3× video-reference → 2× text-gen → video-reference → video-concat → video-subtitle → text-gen → download

requires.name: Autonomous Trend-Detection & Rapid-Response Pipeline — product from the library

notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Trend Scanner searches current social platforms for rising formats (view velocity, repost/like ratio as an early-signal proxy) → Brand-Fit Reasoner screens each candidate trend against brand tone/values (discard trends that are off-brand or reputationally risky) → Format Extractor breaks the winning trend into its exact structural beats and documented failure modes → Adaptation Director maps a brand product into those beats → Nano Banana Pro + Omni Flash 1.1 produce the piece → Trend-Fidelity + Brand-Fit dual critic → Repair → Same-day Export → Alert delivered to the marketing team with a recommended posting window while the trend is still rising, not after it peaks.
STAGE 1 — TREND SCANNER No trend is given — the system finds one. The scrape lane stands in for the platform scan: a rising-format query, scraped and randomised each run.
STAGE 2 — BRAND-FIT REASONER + FORMAT EXTRACTOR Screens each candidate against brand tone and risk, then breaks the winner into its exact structural beats and documented failure modes.
STAGE 3 — ADAPTATION DIRECTOR + PRODUCTION The brand product is mapped into the extracted beats and produced.
STAGE 4 — DUAL CRITIC + SAME-DAY EXPORT Trend fidelity and brand fit scored together, then exported for the recommended posting window.
